name: SCC and Chunk-Peeling Width Hierarchies
statement: For each integer k >= 1, $\mathsf U_k\subseteq\mathsf U_{k+1}$, $\mathsf P_k\subseteq\mathsf P_{k+1}$ and $\mathsf U_k\subseteq\mathsf P_k$. Moreover $\mathsf U_1=\mathsf P_1=\mathsf{Damp}$, $\bigcup_k\mathsf U_k=\mathsf{Rep}$ and $\bigcup_k\mathsf P_k=\mathsf{Amp}$.
proof: Acyclic representations have singleton SCCs and characterize corner peeling. Every finite representation has finite SCC size; every finite ample class can be deleted as a single chunk. Deleting source components preserves ampleness, so each bounded-SCC representation supplies the corresponding chunk peeling.
